worker_rule: durable committed intent may complete necessary work after original staff departs; current system policy/tenant/source version checked; no worker grants new discretionary user authority
console_rule: separate workforce audience and grants; business owner session never Console; recorded reason and case/action scope; no blanket impersonation
preset_rule: Scope/field/state/assurance restrictions always apply; owner must deliberately opt staff into consequential optional grants. Manager defaults exclude refunds approval/bank/policy/customer export; refund.request is request only.
customer_scope: relationship/verified guest manage credential and participant grant; never email/name matching alone; customer wallet.issue only own eligible loyalty holder
own_profile_scope: self personal preferences; team profile changes limited published fields; public publication requires team.manage
